parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path and carries is_sample_app=false but is structurally a sample-app file by its directory location (WallpaperSampleApp). Per the decision rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint. Additionally, both records are anonymous type-alias-objects with empty fields_or_signature lists, providing no shared structural content to extract. Consolidating these would couple production DebugPanel code to sample-app demonstration semantics without any concrete shared interface to unify.
